editorial_team.name: Gstarcademy Editorial Team
editorial_team.bio: An editorial team curating CAD-adjacent knowledge for AEC, mechanical, civil, and product-design practitioners. Articles are drafted from official vendor documentation and decades of cumulative practice, then reviewed by domain editors before publication.

editorial_team.name: AEC Review Desk
editorial_team.bio: Senior AEC reviewers verifying BIM, Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Navisworks and standards-related material against current vendor documentation and live project practice.

editorial_team.name: Mechanical Review Desk
editorial_team.bio: Mechanical reviewers covering SOLIDWORKS, Inventor, Fusion 360, CATIA, Creo, NX, GstarCAD Mechanical, and downstream CAM/PLM workflows.

editorial_team.name: Data Exchange Review Desk
editorial_team.bio: Reviewers focused on file-format interoperability, IFC/STEP/DWG round-trips, and CAD data exchange standards.
